page.layout: One page, one column pair: names on the left, "cap." numbers on the right, in alphabetical order with letter headings O., P., Q. between them. Running head at top. Gathering signature at foot left.
page.notes: Long s in the printed headwords (Papismus, Pepusiani, Priscillianistæ, Psalliani) normalised to plain s. Running head "PRIMVS." given as PRIMUS. Signature "ũ.iiij" read with a tilde over the u; the tilde is faint. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is present in the cap. column and was left out. Roman numerals kept as printed (e.g. xcj, xlij). The first cap. number on the first line and the O./P./Q. letters are clear.
